name: Mohave Crossroads Shopping Center
summary: Mohave Crossroads Shopping Center is a popular community shopping destination in Bullhead City featuring Target, Ross, and PetSmart among its tenant mix. With over 2,300 reviews and a 4.3-star rating, this convenient center serves local residents with everyday essentials, discount apparel, and pet supplies.
demographics: Mohave Crossroads Shopping Center serves the Bullhead City area, attracting a diverse mix of middle-income families, retirees, and value-conscious shoppers typical of this Colorado River community. The trade area draws from both local residents and visitors to this tourism-oriented region, with demographics skewing toward budget-minded consumers seeking everyday essentials and practical shopping options. Primary visitors include households looking for convenient access to pet supplies, discount apparel, and general merchandise, reflecting the area's working-class and retirement community composition.
description: Mohave Crossroads Shopping Center is a convenient community shopping destination located at 3699 Arizona 95 in Bullhead City, serving the tri-state area along the Colorado River. This open-air shopping center has earned a solid 4.3-star rating from over 2,300 reviews, reflecting its popularity among local residents and visitors alike. The center features a practical mix of national retailers including Target, Ross Dress for Less, and PetSmart, making it a one-stop destination for everyday shopping needs from clothing and home goods to pet supplies. Shoppers appreciate the center's clean, well-maintained environment and friendly atmosphere, with recent feedback highlighting the excellent selection of linens, shoes, purses, and pet products. Operating daily from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM, Mohave Crossroads Shopping Center provides accessible, value-oriented shopping in the heart of Bullhead City's retail corridor.
